spec: draft-zambo-aer1-23 anchor outcome reporting: a verifier response carries a machine-visible per-anchor report that keeps three states distinct. 'absent': the receipt carries no anchor member. 'not checked': an anchor is present but the verifier did not evaluate it; this state MUST NOT collapse into an evaluated outcome. Otherwise the evaluated outcome of draft Section 6 step 5: 'verified' (anchor evaluates clean), 'verification failed' (a recomputed or stored anchor value does not match what was committed), or 'rejected: unresolvable record' (the anchor's record cannot be resolved at all, a resource outcome). The gap this pins: an independent validator exercised on the anchored-unresolvable-anchor fixture had no 'not checked' state, so a verifier that never attempted resolution was indistinguishable from one that attempted and failed (Skitter's finding against the independent validator; a-messenger sharpened it into the reporting rule). The report is scoped to the Section 3.3 profile: an anchor member carrying none of the profile's members is a different anchoring record under the same member name (production receipts carry a Nostr publication record there) and reports 'absent', while a partial profile anchor is present and fails evaluation. Fixtures are the existing anchored corpus, one unanchored valid receipt, and one valid receipt carrying the production Nostr-shaped anchor member inline; resolvability is decided offline by construction (RFC 2606 .invalid hosts never resolve), as in the anchored corpus itself.
